The floor was LOWERED from 281 to 280 by the #346 measured doc-reduction wave, which removed one proven-redundant restatement (the Backoff/§3.8.5 DEFERRED paragraph in the Merge guardrails section, fully restated in the Deferred section — the §3.8.5 citation survives at the backoff.threshold field and the Deferred entry): spec.md is now 275, strictly below the re-anchored floor, and every load-bearing token survived.
